title: Top-dimensional orientations are ±e₁∧⋯∧eₙ almost everywhere, with a measurable sign
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝⁿ = Euclid n be an arbitrary set (no openness is needed), and let R : IMRep V n be an integer multiplicity triple (M, θ, ξ) with M = R.carrier and ξ = R.orient : ℝⁿ → MultiVector n n. Let Hⁿ = μHE[n] and e = ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ). Then there is a measurable σ : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that, for Hⁿ⌞M-almost every y, two things hold: σ(y) = 1 or σ(y) = −1, and ξ(y)(α) = σ(y)·α(e) for every n-covector α ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)) (R : IMRep V n), ∃ σ : Euclid n → ℝ, Measurable σ ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), (σ y = 1 ∨ σ y = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid n) n, R.orient y α = σ y * α ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
